name: microservice-scaffold
description: A template repository for building small, HTTP-based Node.js microservices behind a single routing frontend (the Overseer).

scripts.ci: npm run typecheck --workspaces && npm run lint --workspaces && npm test && npm run test:types
scripts.docker:build:generic: MICROSERVICES='*' sh scripts/emit-effective-dockerfile.sh && docker build -f Dockerfile.effective --build-arg MICROSERVICES='*' -t scaffold:generic .
scripts.docker:build:microservice1-microservice2: MICROSERVICES=microservice1,microservice2 sh scripts/emit-effective-dockerfile.sh && docker build -f Dockerfile.effective --build-arg MICROSERVICES=microservice1,microservice2 -t scaffold:microservice1-microservice2 .
scripts.docker:build: npm run docker:build:generic && npm run docker:build:microservice1-microservice2
